title: SAP NetWeaver: attackers can read data they should not see
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed, but the vulnerability is more than a year old and we see no ransomware use, public attack tools, internet-facing product, critical severity or high prediction score. Check whether it applies to you.
rankWhy: Exploitation is confirmed by an authoritative source.

category.label: Business software
category.why: It runs day-to-day business work such as finance, printing, phones or manufacturing.
category.doThis: Ask the vendor or the team that owns it whether the fix is in.

summary: SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal contains an improper neutralization of special elements in data query logic vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to disclose or modify server information via injected JNDI environment properties or a URL used during JNDI lookup operations.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Nov 23, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.
